import.defaultTarget: Used inside other sentences when the bibliography file has no known name

endnote.title: Card heading listing the three supported bibliography formats. Keep the format names verbatim.

zotero.connect: Small button in the Zotero card, shown when no Zotero account is saved. It closes this dialog and opens Settings at Integrations, Zotero.
zotero.limited: Appended after the import summary when the Zotero library is larger than Oleafly reads in one import. {{fetched}} and {{total}} are item counts.
zotero.title: Card heading for the Zotero import path. Keep the product name verbatim.

tabs.citations: Tab listing the project's bibliography entries
tabs.results: Tab listing the locations found by the last Find References run
tabs.symbols: Tab listing labels, commands, and environments the project defines

trees.citations: Accessible name of the citation tree
trees.symbols: Accessible name of the symbol tree

completion.library: Shown at the end of an autocomplete row for a paper from the user's own Zotero library (not a group library).
completion.authorsTwo: Author names in a citation autocomplete row, for a paper with exactly two authors. Names are family names, kept as written.
completion.authorsMany: Author names in a citation autocomplete row, for a paper with three or more authors. Use the usual short form for 'and others' in citations.
completion.noYear: Abbreviation for 'no date', shown where a citation's year would be. Use the usual citation-style abbreviation.

keySource.bbt: Says where the citation key of this paper comes from: the Better BibTeX plugin. Keep 'Better BibTeX' verbatim.
keySource.extra: The 'Extra' field is a named field in Zotero's item editor. Use Zotero's own name for it in this language.

hint.apiDisabled: The quoted text is the exact label of a checkbox in Zotero's Settings > Advanced pane. Use Zotero's own wording for that label in this language if Zotero is translated, otherwise keep the English label.
hint.closedCached: {{time}} is a relative time such as '5 minutes ago'.

actions.update: Button on a bibliography entry that replaces the entry with the current version from Zotero.

handList.description: Shown the first time the user cites a Zotero paper in a LaTeX document whose reference list is typed into the document itself instead of coming from a .bib file. {{path}} is the .bib file the list moves into, such as references.bib. After the move, both sets of references are numbered together in one list.
handList.confirm: Button that moves the hand-typed reference list into the .bib file and then adds the citation.

missing.duplicateRow: {{key}} is the citation key used in the document; {{existing}} is the key of the same paper already in the .bib file.
